cluster_design.icc_retired_reason: Within-session pairing cancels the shared session effect, so the session-level SD already embeds clustering. Retired by estimand amendment v1 (ratified by Nico 2026-08-30, docs/DECISIONES_NICO_2026-08-30.md D1). The prior conservative assumption (0.2) is superseded; the GC bootstrap CI95 [0.0254, 0.5317] was too wide to use.

coverage.effective_sessions_source: All 234 pre-holdout CME sessions have K_ABS creation events; equal session weights imply Kish effective sessions = 234 before cell-specific exclusions

effect_design.mde_justification: RATIFIED_BY_NICO_2026-08-30 (docs/DECISIONES_NICO_2026-08-30.md D1): adopted MDE 2.90 ticks. The authorized 2.861 was the exact MDE@234 knife edge (235 required > 234 available, not implementable as written); 2.90 is a weaker claim, hence conservative, and stays below 3.360, the GC CI95 lower bound.
effect_design.paired_session_sd_source: GC_TRANSFER_PRE_OUTCOME: paired session-level contrast SD 11.528529 ticks measured on GC Gate 1 all-5 (result payload sha256 a307a12c441d82877590a20c59aa1079d590de2cdbb6d55180caaec21622ca53), an upper bound for NQ under the same estimand (NQ cell caps 5-30 ticks / 25-250 obs bind tighter than GC tick_cap 2000 / clock_cap 900s; 652.54 vs 72.39 events per session). Pairing cancels the shared session effect (rho = 0.5617, variance reduction 48.06%). Replaces the earlier finite-support Popoviciu bound (SD <= 60), which was valid but too conservative to authorize.
